purpose: Port the Task 2 listwise glyph reranker (a component of the v5 production gain) to Task 3, where no reranker exists. The reranker may only permute scores inside the existing top-K shortlist, so candidate recall is unchanged and any effect is purely ordering.
scope: Only test/03_task3_single_trial/83_task3_listwise_reranker. src/ is read-only; src/reranker.py is imported, not modified.

data.eeg: public train only, 50 ms log1p counts, per-session z-score on the three training repeats

base_scores.recipe: production-style Task 3 score: equal row-z fusion of (a) MLP logits, (b) encoding prototype response scores and (c) softmax-expected DCT continuous similarity
base_scores.mlp_recipe: SpikeClassifier hidden 1024, dropout 0, seed 42, 10 fixed epochs, identical to experiments 74/77/82 so that the MLP-only arm is comparable
base_scores.internal_check: the MLP-only arm on fold 4 must reproduce experiment 82 base exactly: top1 0.015625 / 0.007710, recall32 0.179267 / 0.112923, fold-4 OCF 16.126378 / 14.725502; a mismatch voids the experiment
base_scores.three_branch_reference: the three-branch base has no earlier reference under these folds; it is reported as the comparison arm

reranker.training_rows: OOF rows from folds 1, 2 and 3 only: for each such fold the classifier is trained on the other three repeats and predicts the held repeat
reranker.evaluation_fold: fold 4, whose classifier is also trained on repeats 1-3 and predicts repeat 4; fold-4 rows are never seen by the reranker
reranker.hyperparameter_source: copied unchanged from the Task 2 production reranker; no tuning
reranker.assignment: Hungarian after the top-K permutation, exactly as in production

metrics.ocf: official OCF on fold 4, RNG123 heldout pictures [256:768], per session and per mouse
metrics.top1: held argmax identity accuracy on fold 4
metrics.recall32: must be unchanged between arms by construction; reported as a check

pass_rule.advance: fold-4 OCF gain over base is at least +0.30 for BOTH mice, at least 5 of 8 mouse x session groups are non-negative, and fold-4 top1 is not lower for either mouse
pass_rule.basis: 0.30 is above the assignment-noise band measured in experiments 79 and 80
pass_rule.otherwise: the Task 3 reranker is rejected and the Task 2 component is not ported

prohibited: tuning reranker epochs, k, top_n or seed on any held fold
letting a candidate enter or leave the base top-32
reporting a gain that depends on changing the base scoring recipe
